Portraits go here.

Name each file after the person and it appears automatically:

  ansary.jpg   ashik.jpg   morsheda.jpg   atik.jpg
  maria.jpg    maimuna.jpg anas.jpg       arafat.jpg

Until a file exists the page shows a placeholder naming the file it wants,
so nothing looks broken while you are still gathering photographs.

Square-ish images work everywhere; the pages crop rather than stretch.
After adding one, run:  npm run build
